item.title: In-N-Out Burger employee among 3 dead in shooting at Idaho fast-food restaurant, owner says
item.description: The owner of a fast-food restaurant chain says one of her workers was among three people killed in a shooting in southern Idaho The shooting happened Saturday at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho.
